In addition, it is dependent on time frame in which you observe pattern. For three days bears wasn't able to close below blue line and bulls were fighting drawing strength from demand ( 1 ). On the fourth day support is broken and days closes below blue line ( 3 ). In addition, it is dependent on time frame in which you observe pattern. For three days bears wasn't able to close below blue line and bulls were fighting drawing strength from demand ( 1 ). On the fourth day support is broken and days closes below blue line ( 3 ). In addition, it is dependent on time frame in which you observe pattern. For three days bears wasn't able to close below blue line and bulls were fighting drawing strength from demand ( 1 ). On the fourth day support is broken and days closes below blue line ( 3 ). In addition, it is dependent on time frame in which you observe pattern. For three days bears wasn't able to close below blue line and bulls were fighting drawing strength from demand ( 1 ). On the fourth day support is broken and days closes below blue line ( 3 ).
